paragraphs.text: But concerning the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that aught be written unto you.
paragraphs.original: Περὶ δὲ τῶν χρόνων καὶ τῶν καιρῶν, ἀδελφοί, οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε ὑμῖν γράφεσθαι,
paragraphs.translit: Peri de tōn chronōn kai tōn kairōn, adelphoi, ou chreian echete hymin graphesthai,

paragraphs.text: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
paragraphs.original: αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀκριβῶς οἴδατε ὅτι ἡμέρα κυρίου ὡς κλέπτης ἐν νυκτὶ οὕτως ἔρχεται.
paragraphs.translit: autoi gar akribōs oidate hoti hēmera kyriou hōs kleptēs en nykti houtōs erchetai.

paragraphs.text: When they are saying, Peace and safety, then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall in no wise escape.
paragraphs.original: ὅταν λέγωσιν· Εἰρήνη καὶ ἀσφάλεια, τότε αἰφνίδιος αὐτοῖς ἐφίσταται ὄλεθρος ὥσπερ ἡ ὠδὶν τῇ ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσῃ, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐκφύγωσιν.
paragraphs.translit: hotan legōsin· Eirēnē kai asphaleia, tote aiphnidios autois ephistatai olethros hōsper hē ōdin tē en gastri echousē, kai ou mē ekphygōsin.

paragraphs.text: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief:
paragraphs.original: ὑμεῖς δέ, ἀδελφοί, οὐκ ἐστὲ ἐν σκότει, ἵνα ἡ ἡμέρα ὑμᾶς ὡς κλέπτης καταλάβῃ,
paragraphs.translit: hymeis de, adelphoi, ouk este en skotei, hina hē hēmera hymas hōs kleptēs katalabē,

paragraphs.text: for ye are all sons of light, and sons of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness;
paragraphs.original: πάντες γὰρ ὑμεῖς υἱοὶ φωτός ἐστε καὶ υἱοὶ ἡμέρας. οὐκ ἐσμὲν νυκτὸς οὐδὲ σκότους·
paragraphs.translit: pantes gar hymeis hyioi phōtos este kai hyioi hēmeras. ouk esmen nyktos oude skotous·

paragraphs.text: so then let us not sleep, as do the rest, but let us watch and be sober.
paragraphs.original: ἄρα οὖν μὴ καθεύδωμεν ὡς οἱ λοιποί, ἀλλὰ γρηγορῶμεν καὶ νήφωμεν.
paragraphs.translit: ara oun mē katheudōmen hōs hoi loipoi, alla grēgorōmen kai nēphōmen.

paragraphs.text: For they that sleep sleep in the night: and they that are drunken are drunken in the night.
paragraphs.original: οἱ γὰρ καθεύδοντες νυκτὸς καθεύδουσιν, καὶ οἱ μεθυσκόμενοι νυκτὸς μεθύουσιν·
paragraphs.translit: hoi gar katheudontes nyktos katheudousin, kai hoi methyskomenoi nyktos methyousin·

paragraphs.text: But let us, since we are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.
paragraphs.original: ἡμεῖς δὲ ἡμέρας ὄντες νήφωμεν, ἐνδυσάμενοι θώρακα πίστεως καὶ ἀγάπης καὶ περικεφαλαίαν ἐλπίδα σωτηρίας·
paragraphs.translit: hēmeis de hēmeras ontes nēphōmen, endysamenoi thōraka pisteōs kai agapēs kai perikephalaian elpida sōtērias·

paragraphs.text: For God appointed us not into wrath, but unto the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
paragraphs.original: ὅτι οὐκ ἔθετο ἡμᾶς ὁ θεὸς εἰς ὀργὴν ἀλλὰ εἰς περιποίησιν σωτηρίας διὰ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: hoti ouk etheto hēmas ho theos eis orgēn alla eis peripoiēsin sōtērias dia tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou,

paragraphs.text: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
paragraphs.original: τοῦ ἀποθανόντος περὶ ἡμῶν ἵνα εἴτε γρηγορῶμεν εἴτε καθεύδωμεν ἅμα σὺν αὐτῷ ζήσωμεν.
paragraphs.translit: tou apothanontos peri hēmōn hina eite grēgorōmen eite katheudōmen hama syn autō zēsōmen.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as also ye do.
paragraphs.original: διὸ παρακαλεῖτε ἀλλήλους καὶ οἰκοδομεῖτε εἷς τὸν ἕνα, καθὼς καὶ ποιεῖτε.
paragraphs.translit: dio parakaleite allēlous kai oikodomeite heis ton hena, kathōs kai poieite.

paragraphs.text: But we beseech you, brethren, to know them that labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
paragraphs.original: Ἐρωτῶμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, εἰδέναι τοὺς κοπιῶντας ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ προϊσταμένους ὑμῶν ἐν κυρίῳ καὶ νουθετοῦντας ὑμᾶς,
paragraphs.translit: Erōtōmen de hymas, adelphoi, eidenai tous kopiōntas en hymin kai proistamenous hymōn en kyriō kai nouthetountas hymas,

paragraphs.text: and to esteem them exceeding highly in love for their work`s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἡγεῖσθαι αὐτοὺς ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ διὰ τὸ ἔργον αὐτῶν. εἰρηνεύετε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: kai hēgeisthai autous hyperekperissou en agapē dia to ergon autōn. eirēneuete en heautois.

paragraphs.text: And we exhort you, brethren, admonish the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be longsuffering toward all.
paragraphs.original: παρακαλοῦμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, νουθετεῖτε τοὺς ἀτάκτους, παραμυθεῖσθε τοὺς ὀλιγοψύχους, ἀντέχεσθε τῶν ἀσθενῶν, μακροθυμεῖτε πρὸς πάντας.
paragraphs.translit: parakaloumen de hymas, adelphoi, noutheteite tous ataktous, paramytheisthe tous oligopsychous, antechesthe tōn asthenōn, makrothymeite pros pantas.

paragraphs.text: See that none render unto any one evil for evil; but always follow after that which is good, one toward another, and toward all.
paragraphs.original: ὁρᾶτε μή τις κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ τινι ἀποδῷ, ἀλλὰ πάντοτε τὸ ἀγαθὸν διώκετε εἰς ἀλλήλους καὶ εἰς πάντας.
paragraphs.translit: horate mē tis kakon anti kakou tini apodō, alla pantote to agathon diōkete eis allēlous kai eis pantas.

paragraphs.text: Rejoice always;
paragraphs.original: πάντοτε χαίρετε,
paragraphs.translit: pantote chairete,

paragraphs.text: pray without ceasing;
paragraphs.original: ἀδιαλείπτως προσεύχεσθε,
paragraphs.translit: adialeiptōs proseuchesthe,

paragraphs.text: in everything give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus to you-ward.
paragraphs.original: ἐν παντὶ εὐχαριστεῖτε· τοῦτο γὰρ θέλημα θεοῦ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: en panti eucharisteite· touto gar thelēma theou en Christō Iēsou eis hymas.

paragraphs.text: Quench not the Spirit;
paragraphs.original: τὸ πνεῦμα μὴ σβέννυτε,
paragraphs.translit: to pneuma mē sbennyte,

paragraphs.text: despise not prophesyings;
paragraphs.original: προφητείας μὴ ἐξουθενεῖτε·
paragraphs.translit: prophēteias mē exoutheneite·

paragraphs.text: prove all things; hold fast that which is good;
paragraphs.original: πάντα δὲ δοκιμάζετε, τὸ καλὸν κατέχετε,
paragraphs.translit: panta de dokimazete, to kalon katechete,

paragraphs.text: abstain from every form of evil.
paragraphs.original: ἀπὸ παντὸς εἴδους πονηροῦ ἀπέχεσθε.
paragraphs.translit: apo pantos eidous ponērou apechesthe.

paragraphs.text: And the God of peace himself sanctify you wholly; and may your spirit and soul and body be preserved entire, without blame at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης ἁγιάσαι ὑμᾶς ὁλοτελεῖς, καὶ ὁλόκληρον ὑμῶν τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ καὶ τὸ σῶμα ἀμέμπτως ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τηρηθείη.
paragraphs.translit: Autos de ho theos tēs eirēnēs hagiasai hymas holoteleis, kai holoklēron hymōn to pneuma kai hē psychē kai to sōma amemptōs en tē parousia tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou tērētheiē.

paragraphs.text: Faithful is he that calleth you, who will also do it.
paragraphs.original: πιστὸς ὁ καλῶν ὑμᾶς, ὃς καὶ ποιήσει.
paragraphs.translit: pistos ho kalōn hymas, hos kai poiēsei.

paragraphs.text: Brethren, pray for us.
paragraphs.original: Ἀδελφοί, προσεύχεσθε περὶ ἡμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Adelphoi, proseuchesthe peri hēmōn.

paragraphs.text: Salute all the brethren with a holy kiss.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς πάντας ἐν φιλήματι ἁγίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe tous adelphous pantas en philēmati hagiō.

paragraphs.text: I adjure you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the brethren.
paragraphs.original: ἐνορκίζω ὑμᾶς τὸν κύριον ἀναγνωσθῆναι τὴν ἐπιστολὴν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: enorkizō hymas ton kyrion anagnōsthēnai tēn epistolēn pasin tois adelphois.

paragraphs.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
paragraphs.original: ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μεθʼ ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: hē charis tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou methʼ hymōn.
